title: Building the Engine While Flying the Plane: Launching the Figma MCP Server — Jesse Lumarie, Figma
talk_summary: Figma built its MCP server in about three months, starting local and later remote, to pass design/code context to AI clients. The transferable lessons are sparse context representations, automated evals, and tool-level workarounds for missing client features.

takeaways.technique: Sparse pointers instead of full code dumps
takeaways.what_they_do: They convert design context into sparse references to canonical code components rather than sending full generated markup.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you go from like this big old thing of uh react tailin to the small react component that just says use button component.

takeaways.what_they_do: They stopped embedding base64 image data in code context and instead abstracted images to top-level references.
takeaways.evidence_quote: passing B 64 data into the code and that was just a terrible idea. It it just blew up the context window

takeaways.technique: Automated eval harness with LLM judges
takeaways.what_they_do: They replaced manual spreadsheet grading with an automated eval that runs frequently and uses LLM judges for prompt changes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we have a um, eval that sort of runs like hundreds of times a week
takeaways.numbers: hundreds of eval runs per week

takeaways.what_they_do: Because clients did not implement server instructions, they embedded usage guidance directly in each tool call.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we would add uh additional instructions into each tool call. Basically instructing the LLM how to use our server

takeaways.what_they_do: When clients lacked interactive features, they encoded ask-user permission and codebase-scan steps as explicit tool calls, then batched results.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we were able to kind of hack around it using tools.

takeaways.what_they_do: They found that passing an image alone was weak, but image plus code context improved agent output.
takeaways.evidence_quote: having the code context plus the image actually had better agentic output.
